title: European Football Roundup: Historic Routs, Continental Comebacks, and Monumental Commitments

stories.title: Como Rout Lens 9-1 in Record-Breaking Bigger Cup Match
stories.details: Cesc Fàbregas's Como side delivered a historic 9-1 thrashing of French club Lens at Stade Bollaert-Delelis, recording the biggest winning margin in Bigger Cup history. Ruben Aguilar struck a thunderous volley for Lens's lone goal, while teenage substitutes Mattia Liberali and Matteo Papaccioli sealed the blowout for the Italian side. Despite the victory, Fàbregas urged his squad to stay humble, expressing frustration at conceding to his former Monaco teammate Aguilar.

stories.title: Liverpool Fall 3-2 to Fenerbahce in Error-Strewn Away Clash
stories.details: Liverpool succumbed to a 3-2 defeat against Fenerbahce in Istanbul despite holding a 2-1 lead with 21 minutes left to play. Head coach Andoni Iraola expressed sharp displeasure at the manner of the defeat, criticizing the cheap and messy goals his team conceded. The defensive errors revived painful memories in Istanbul for the English club.

stories.title: Manchester City Prevail in Five-Goal Thriller at RB Leipzig
stories.details: Manchester City secured a dramatic 3-2 victory away against RB Leipzig. Striker Erling Haaland settled the back-and-forth contest in favour of the English club. The victory kept Manchester City on track following an intense European battle in Germany.

stories.title: Federico Valverde Rescues Real Madrid at AEK Athens
stories.details: Real Madrid overcame AEK Athens after falling behind twice during their away fixture in Greece. Midfielder Federico Valverde struck a decisive 92nd-minute winner to seal the comeback for the Spanish giants. The result completed a hard-fought European turnaround for the visitors.

stories.title: Harry Kane Commits to Bayern Munich Through 2029
stories.details: Striker Harry Edward 'Ballon d'Or' Kane has agreed to a contract extension keeping him at Bayern Munich until 2029, the year he turns 36. Kane expressed his affection for the club, its supporters, and the city, stating that he feels right at home in Germany. The extension solidifies Bayern's long-term commitment to their leading goalscorer.

stories.title: David Raya Eyes Redemption Following Shootout Agony
stories.details: Arsenal goalkeeper David Raya emphasized that the squad must channel the pain of last season's Bigger Cup final penalty shootout defeat into motivation. Raya stated that the squad needs that heartbreak to be in their veins as the Gunners seek European glory this season. Arsenal aim to go one step further in continental competition after falling just short last campaign.

stories.title: Scott Parker Leads Dramatic West Ham Comeback on Dugout Debut
stories.details: Scott Parker's first match in charge of West Ham produced a spirited comeback as the London club rallied from three goals down to draw 3-3 at Cardiff. Parker admitted after the final whistle that the half-time team talk had been difficult with his side trailing 3-0. The resilient second-half display secured a dramatic point on his managerial debut.

stories.title: Clara Serrajordi Shines in Barcelona Midfield Succession
stories.details: 18-year-old midfielder Clara Serrajordi has emerged as a key figure in Pere Romeu's Barcelona squad following the departure of Alexia Putellas to London City Lionesses. Serrajordi, who started the 2026 Champions League final against OL Lyonnes, described earning a first-team place as a dream for every academy player. She noted that while Barcelona midfielders share a distinct stylistic identity, she remains focused on continuing to improve.

title: Global Pitch: Power, Tragedy, and Upheaval in World Football

stories.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Announces International Retirement from Portugal
stories.details: Forward Cristiano Ronaldo has brought an end to his 23-year international career with Portugal, stepping away after accumulating 234 caps and a world-record 146 goals. Ronaldo revealed he has handed back the No. 7 shirt, explaining that the emotional decision came after he walked out following a dispute with head coach Jorge Jesus. His career featured six World Cup appearances, a European title, and the all-time international scoring benchmark.

stories.title: Gianni Infantino Proposes Ukraine Ceasefire for Qatar World Cup
stories.details: FIFA president Gianni Infantino proposed a temporary ceasefire in Ukraine during an address to G20 leaders over lunch in Bali, arguing that the Qatar 2022 World Cup could serve as a positive trigger for peace. Infantino framed the tournament as a unique platform for global unity despite ongoing criticism over migrant worker rights and human rights issues in Qatar. His speech followed earlier correspondence urging participating football associations to avoid ideological disputes and focus entirely on the pitch.

stories.title: Kozo Tashima Launches Bid Against Gianni Infantino for FIFA Leadership
stories.details: Japan Football Association head Kozo Tashima announced his candidacy to run against incumbent Gianni Infantino in the upcoming March presidential election. Tashima's challenge sets up a contested race for the leadership of world football's governing body. The election comes amid ongoing debates over tournament expansions, geopolitical influence, and tournament governance.

stories.title: FIFA Weighs Age Restrictions for Women's Olympic Tournament
stories.details: FIFA has floated a controversial policy proposal to limit women's Olympic football competitions to under-23 players. Under consideration by football's governing body, the rule change could be introduced in time for the 2032 Brisbane Olympic Games. The shift would bring women's Olympic competition closer in structure to the men's Olympic tournament.

stories.title: Brazilian Youth Match Erupts into Record 53 Red Cards
stories.details: An under-20 state championship semi-final between Uberlândia and Mamoré descended into chaos, resulting in a world-record 53 red cards issued by referee Fernando Patrick Drosghic Modesto. The melee was triggered after Mamoré's Davi taunted opponents while celebrating an extra-time goal, leading to dismissals for 43 players, eight coaches, and two club executives. Due to safety concerns and dressing room vandalism, Uberlândia subsequently forfeited the second leg, sending Mamoré through to the final.

stories.title: Spain Mourns Tenerife Forward Jesús de Miguel After Fatal Collision
stories.details: Family, friends, and fellow footballers gathered in the Spanish village of Navahermosa for the funeral of Tenerife striker Jesús de Miguel. The forward passed away following an on-field collision suffered during a match against FC Andorra. In an emotional tribute, his family stated that the widespread affection and impact he had on others will be carried with them forever.

stories.title: Heimir Hallgrímsson Emphasizes Team Unity Following Israel Fixtures
stories.details: Republic of Ireland soccer manager Heimir Hallgrímsson indicated his desire to draw a definitive line under recent matches against Israel. Hallgrímsson remarked that navigating the challenges of the games had united the Ireland squad more than ever before. The manager is focused on moving forward with a solidified and focused international group.

stories.title: Ashton United Submit Loan Proposal for Erling Haaland
stories.details: Northern Premier League Division club Ashton United submitted an audacious loan bid to sign Manchester City forward Erling Haaland during the World Cup break. Manager Michael Clegg stated that the proposal made sense to keep the striker match-fit rather than having him spend six weeks playing golf. Manchester City are not playing competitive fixtures during the tournament window.

title: Major League Soccer Decision Day Climax and USMNT International Reinforcements

stories.title: Major League Soccer Prepares for High-Stakes Decision Day
stories.details: Major League Soccer arrives at the climax of its regular season with fifteen matches scheduled across two regional kickoff windows on Decision Day. Eight fixtures will kick off simultaneously on the East Coast at 4pm ET, followed hours later by seven Western Conference clashes. The final slate will determine final playoff positions, seeding, and regular-season award races across the league.

stories.title: Sporting KC and CF Montréal Battle to Avoid Wooden Spoon
stories.details: Sporting Kansas City enter Decision Day trailing CF Montréal by three points in a bid to avoid finishing at the bottom of the overall MLS standings. A victory by Sporting KC over San Diego paired with a Montréal defeat to Vancouver would level both clubs on 26 points. Under MLS tiebreaker criteria, Sporting KC would claim seven victories compared to Montréal's six, allowing them to escape the fan-created Wooden Spoon award.

stories.title: Inter Miami Seek No. 2 Seed as Lionel Messi Chases Historic Golden Boot
stories.details: Inter Miami will guarantee the No. 2 seed in the Eastern Conference playoffs if they secure a Decision Day victory over Charlotte. Star forward Lionel Messi enters the match with 26 goals, leading his closest competitor by four and putting him on track to become the first player in MLS history to win consecutive Golden Boot titles. Inter Miami have already secured qualification for the Concacaf Champions Cup despite falling short in the Supporters' Shield race.

stories.title: Eastern Conference Postseason Contenders Eliminated Ahead of Final Day
stories.details: The nine postseason spots in the Eastern Conference were cemented after a late equalizer from CF Montréal officially ended New York City FC's playoff qualification hopes. Red Bull New York will also miss the postseason despite a promising group of homegrown talent under manager Michael Bradley, while Toronto FC suffered a second consecutive missed postseason under Robin Fraser. The results finalized NYC FC's third playoff absence in franchise history after struggling without injured striker Alonso Martínez.

stories.title: Six Western Conference Teams Contest Three Final Playoff Spots
stories.details: The Western Conference postseason race remains open with six teams vying for the final three available positions on Decision Day. The LA Galaxy visit Real Salt Lake in a critical matchup, while the Portland Timbers look to seal qualification against eliminated Austin after winning three straight matches. Meanwhile, the Colorado Rapids, Seattle Sounders, and Minnesota United all remain in contention but require positive results to claim postseason berths.

stories.title: Christian Pulisic and Folarin Balogun Return to USMNT Squad
stories.details: United States Men's National Team players Christian Pulisic and Folarin Balogun have returned to the squad ahead of upcoming Nations League fixtures. Both key attackers were recalled to the national team roster after recovering from injury absences. Their inclusions provide significant attacking reinforcement ahead of competitive regional fixtures.

title: Global Sports, Motorsport and Rugby In-Depth Broadcast

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton Vows to Speak Out Following Leclerc Controversy
stories.details: Lewis Hamilton asserted that he will not be silenced after critical remarks regarding Ferrari teammate Charles Leclerc triggered widespread debate following the Mexico City Grand Prix. The British driver faced pushback over his post-race assessment but reaffirmed his right to express honest perspectives. The controversy comes as tensions simmer within the garage in the latter stages of the Formula 1 season.

stories.title: Former Formula One World Champion Alan Jones Dies
stories.details: Alan Jones, the Australian racing driver who captured the 1980 Formula 1 world championship with Williams, has passed away. Jones was remembered across motorsport for his fierce determination, uncompromising racing style, and passion for high speed. His title-winning campaign established him as one of the sport's most colorful and formidable trailblazers.

stories.title: Conor Murray Backs Tactical Clarity Under Noel McNamara
stories.details: Ireland rugby player Conor Murray praised coach Noel McNamara for demonstrating clear tactical vision after contradicting senior player Peter O'Mahony during squad sessions. Writing on national team preparations, Murray stated that the squad has earned the expectation to defeat Argentina, Fiji, and South Africa in the Nations Championship. The veteran back emphasized that clear leadership has positioned the Irish team for high-level international tests.

stories.title: Emlyn Hughes Memorabilia Fetches Big Sums at Liverpool Auction
stories.details: A collection of 247 personal memorabilia items belonging to the late England and Liverpool captain Emlyn Hughes was auctioned in Liverpool. Highlights included Hughes's 1969 debut cap selling for £1,700, his first European Cup winners medal securing £40,000, and his 1977 European Cup final shirt reaching £56,000. An exchanged Hamburg shirt with former teammate Kevin Keegan from the 1977 Super Cup fetched £65,000 ahead of the 22nd anniversary of Hughes's death.

stories.title: Chelsea Appoint Paul Winstanley as Global Talent Director
stories.details: Chelsea have appointed Paul Winstanley as the club's director of global talent and transfers. The hire represents another high-profile staff acquisition from Brighton, where Chelsea previously recruited coaching and recruitment staff. Winstanley will oversee worldwide talent acquisition and transfer strategy for the Premier League side.

title: A Seismic Shift in the American Political Landscape

stories.title: Democrats Secure Decisive Control of Congress in Midterm Elections
stories.details: The Democratic Party took decisive control of the United States Congress following a nationwide wave in the midterm elections, flipping key seats in historically conservative districts. The electoral rout dealt a major defeat to President Donald Trump's Republican administration, leaving Trump facing a divided Washington as a weakened executive. The outcome has reshuffled legislative priorities and heightened scrutiny on major corporate and political allies of the administration.

stories.title: Texas Democrats Celebrate Historic Breakthrough in State Races
stories.details: Texas Democrats scored landmark midterm triumphs as James Talarico and Gina Hinojosa captured election as senator and governor respectively. The candidates achieved victory by moving away from identity-focused platforms to campaign directly on kitchen-table economics and public utility infrastructure. The results flipped long-held Republican leadership across the state and established Texas as a surprising new stronghold for Democratic candidates.

stories.title: Mississippi Senate Race Leans Toward Stunner Democratic Gain
stories.details: Democrats moved within reach of a historic Senate election victory in Mississippi as ballot counting continued in the wake of the midterm elections. The tight contest has heightened anxiety and internal finger-pointing among Republican leadership following unexpected losses in conservative territory. An upset in Mississippi would further consolidate Democratic control of the upper chamber.

stories.title: Deep-Red Kansas Rejects Republican Incumbents Amid Economic Frustration
stories.details: Voters in Kansas turned against Republican candidates during the midterm elections, registering dissatisfaction with federal economic performance and inflation under the Trump administration. Disillusioned voters noted that local businesses and households were suffering under current trade and fiscal policies. The surprising shift underscored growing resistance across traditional agricultural and conservative bastions.

stories.title: Keisha Lance Bottoms Wins Georgia Gubernatorial Election
stories.details: Former Atlanta mayor Keisha Lance Bottoms won election as the new governor-elect of Georgia as Democrats expanded their footprint across the southern United States. Bottoms, the daughter of soul recording artist Major Lance, centered her campaign on public services, economic relief, and responsible tech development. Her victory marked another critical flip of a major southern executive mansion.

stories.title: Melania Trump Welcomes Ukrainian and Russian Delegates at White House
stories.details: First Lady Melania Trump hosted delegates from both Russia and Ukraine during an official gathering at the White House. During the meeting, she received diplomatic gifts and commended bilateral cooperation regarding a localized ceasefire arranged in the Russian-occupied town of Oleshky. The engagement highlighted diplomatic outreach amid ongoing geopolitical conflict in Eastern Europe.

stories.title: Conservative Sports Team Owners Face Fallout from Republican Losses
stories.details: High-profile professional sports franchise owners who contributed heavily to Republican midterm campaigns are confronting unexpected political consequences following sweeping Democratic victories. Significant campaign investments yielded minimal legislative leverage as key conservative candidates suffered defeats nationwide. The shift in congressional control is expected to alter legislative scrutiny over professional sports business practices.

title: Big Tech Reckoning: Market Rout, Regulatory Crosshairs, and Infrastructure Freezes

stories.title: Global Financial Markets Slump Following Post-Midterm AI Sell-Off
stories.details: Global stock exchanges suffered steep losses after Wall Street tumbled, erasing more than $3.2 trillion in equity value as investors anticipated a clampdown on artificial intelligence. The tech-heavy Nasdaq recorded a 5.5% drop—its steepest single-day decline in 19 months—while Asian benchmarks including South Korea's Kospi and Taiwan's Taiex plummeted sharply. Semiconductor manufacturers including Nvidia, SanDisk, and Micron led the drop over concerns regarding future datacenter expansion and computing investment.

stories.title: Incoming Congressional Majority Promises Inquiries into Big Tech
stories.details: Leading Democratic lawmakers announced plans for comprehensive congressional investigations and subpoenas examining major Silicon Valley corporations following their midterm triumphs. Senator Jon Ossoff warned that Big Tech must be brought to heel, while Senator Ed Markey pledged extensive subpoena campaigns aimed at corporate leadership. Initial document preservation notices have already been dispatched to tech titans Nvidia and Amazon.

stories.title: Governors-Elect Coordinate Freeze on Hyperscale Datacenter Projects
stories.details: Newly elected Democratic governors, including Gina Hinojosa in Texas, Amy Acton in Ohio, and Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia, announced plans to implement moratoriums on new datacenter construction. The incoming state executives campaigned heavily against the noisy, resource-heavy facilities that consume massive amounts of local water and power grid capacity. The planned moratoria threaten to restrict computing infrastructure required by leading artificial intelligence developers.

stories.title: Elon Musk Suffers Staggering Financial and Political Losses
stories.details: Elon Musk saw his net worth fall by more than $40 billion as shares in Tesla and SpaceX tumbled in the wake of the midterm elections. Musk had invested over $450 million supporting conservative candidates, notably backing Ken Paxton in Texas, only to see nearly all of his preferred contenders defeated. Congressional lawmakers have signaled potential scrutiny into Musk's previous government efficiency cuts and proposed corporate mergers between SpaceX and xAI.

stories.title: Major Social Media Companies Sue California Over Youth Addiction Law
stories.details: Tech companies Google, Meta, and TikTok joined together to file a federal lawsuit against the state of California seeking to invalidate child online safety legislation. The companies argue the statute unfairly restricts online features designed to engage users under the banner of preventing behavioral addiction. The legal fight marks a major confrontation between state regulators and dominant social networking platforms over minor protection rules.

stories.title: Google Threatens to Disable Search Access for Schools Resisting AI Tools
stories.details: Google announced it will terminate standard search access for educational institutions that choose to opt out of or restrict its artificial intelligence products. The directive has sparked outrage among educators who argue the search giant is forcing unproven AI integrations onto public school classrooms. School administrators face difficult choices between data privacy compliance and maintaining basic search connectivity.

stories.title: Binance Details Months-Long Thwarted $6.3 Billion Crypto Breach
stories.details: Global cryptocurrency exchange platform Binance disclosed that sophisticated hackers spent months planning an elaborate digital heist targeting $6.3 billion in assets. Company security personnel detected and neutralized the multi-stage cyber assault before funds could be permanently drained. The revelation underscores the escalating scale of institutional cyber threats facing the digital asset industry.

stories.title: Sam Altman Backtracks on Unchecked Superintelligence Development
stories.details: OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman publicly argued that human oversight must constrain technological progress rather than ceding future decision-making to artificial superintelligence. Altman's comments marked an apparent effort to distance OpenAI from unchecked AI deregulation and align with calls for human-centric safety standards. The shift comes as political pressure mounts on artificial intelligence firms facing looming regulatory oversight.

title: UK Justice, Economy and Policy In-Depth: Southwark Verdicts, Rate Hikes and National Restructuring

stories.title: Russell Brand Convicted of Rape and Sexual Assault in London Court
stories.details: Actor and comedian Russell Brand was convicted at Southwark Crown Court on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault spanning offenses between 2004 and 2009. The 51-year-old was remanded into custody without bail, with Mr Justice Bennathan warning him to anticipate a significant custodial sentence at his Monday hearing. Brand was cleared of two additional rape charges and one attempted indecent assault accusation following the three-week proceeding.

stories.title: Appeals Court Lengthens Murder Sentence for Henry Nowak's Killer
stories.details: The Court of Appeal in the UK extended the prison term handed down to the individual convicted of killing Henry Nowak. Appellate judges determined that the original sentence failed to reflect the incomprehensible cruelty inflicted upon the victim. The ruling ensures the perpetrator will spend substantially more time behind bars before being eligible for parole.

stories.title: Met Commissioner Rowley Demands Slashing Police Force Numbers
stories.details: Metropolitan Police Commissioner Sir Mark Rowley stated that drastically reducing the number of individual police forces operating across England and Wales is the only viable path forward. Rowley argued that operating dozens of fragmented local constabularies leads to operational waste, inefficiency, and compromised public safety. His remarks come amid growing calls for comprehensive national restructuring of the UK law enforcement apparatus.

stories.title: Bank of England Lifts Interest Rates to 4% in Tightening Move
stories.details: The Bank of England raised its benchmark borrowing rate to 4%, marking the central bank's first interest rate hike in more than three years. The monetary policy decision pushed the British pound to an 18-month high and prompted an increase in sovereign bond yields across the United Kingdom. Central bank policymakers cautioned that additional monetary tightening could be necessary later this year to counter persistent inflation.

stories.title: UK House Prices Experience Deepest Plunge in Three Years
stories.details: Residential real estate values across the United Kingdom dropped at their steepest rate in over three years, according to newly published housing data. The sharp decline reflects mounting affordability pressures on prospective buyers facing high mortgage rates and elevated living expenses. Analysts warned that the combination of falling home values and higher borrowing costs will continue to weigh heavily on consumer confidence.

stories.title: Telecommunications Firms BT and Virgin Media O2 Announce Mass Layoffs
stories.details: Major British telecommunications operators BT and Virgin Media O2 announced sweeping job reduction programs as part of extensive corporate cost-cutting measures. BT confirmed it is cutting nearly 8,000 positions, while Virgin Media O2 unveiled plans to slash thousands of staff to achieve £800 million in operational savings. The major layoffs highlight significant restructuring pressures within the UK communications sector.

stories.title: Government Pressures UK Energy Suppliers to Assist Indebted Households
stories.details: Government ministers instructed domestic energy suppliers to expand financial assistance programs for UK households struggling with outstanding power bills this winter. Officials warned that mounting customer debt could leave vulnerable families facing severe fuel poverty during the colder months. Energy suppliers were told to implement more flexible repayment options and proactively identify residents at financial risk.

stories.title: Channel 4 Cancels Married at First Sight UK Over Criminal Allegations
stories.details: UK broadcaster Channel 4 pulled the plug on its popular reality series Married at First Sight UK after serious rape allegations emerged. The network decided to axe the franchise entirely following widespread public scrutiny and concern over participant welfare. Television executives acted swiftly to prevent further brand damage and conduct internal reviews into safeguarding protocols.

title: Global Security Alert: Airspace Threats, Political Upheaval, and Economic Crises

stories.title: Bomb Threats Spark Air Transport Chaos Across European Skies
stories.details: European aviation authorities scrambled to respond as dozens of commercial flights operated by multiple airlines were targeted by bomb threats. Military fighter jets were dispatched across several European countries to intercept and escort endangered aircraft to safe landings at regional bases. Security analysts raised alarms that the coordinated disruption could represent an intentional campaign of hybrid warfare aimed at destabilizing European infrastructure.

stories.title: Aer Lingus Captain Investigated Over Reluctance to Land During Threat
stories.details: An Aer Lingus pilot is under formal aviation investigation after initially hesitating to follow air traffic orders to land during an active in-flight bomb scare. Two French military fighter jets were scrambled to escort the aircraft, which ultimately touched down safely at an air force installation in Normandy. Aviation regulators and security officials are probing why emergency diversion protocols were not immediately executed.

stories.title: Paraguayan President Resigns After Catastrophic Online Banking Collapse
stories.details: The president of Paraguay stepped down from office following the sudden failure of a major online financial institution closely tied to his administration. The insolvency froze customer balances, leaving nearly half of the country's population completely unable to withdraw or access their life savings. The catastrophic economic crisis triggered widespread public outrage and political collapse in the South American nation.

stories.title: Over Half a Million French Workers Protest Against President Macron
stories.details: More than 500,000 demonstrators took to the streets across France in a massive general strike opposing the economic policies of President Emmanuel Macron. Protesting unions demanded a 10 percent increase to the national minimum wage alongside €10 billion in emergency funding for public education. The disruptive work stoppages brought transport and public services to a crawl nationwide, compounding pressure on Macron's government.

stories.title: UN Probe Discloses UAE Deployment of Colombian Mercenaries in Sudan
stories.details: A United Nations investigative report revealed that the United Arab Emirates hired foreign mercenaries from Colombia to fight alongside a notorious Sudanese paramilitary organization. The findings document the expanding internationalization of Sudan's brutal armed conflict through private military contracting. UN monitors warned that foreign financial and mercenary assistance is exacerbating atrocities against civilians.

stories.title: World Bank Warns Developing Nation Debt Reaches Unprecedented $9.4tn
stories.details: Global sovereign debt owed by the world's poorest nations has climbed to an all-time peak of $9.4 trillion, according to alarming new statistics published by the World Bank. Developing economies are facing severe debt-servicing burdens that threaten to strip away funding from critical healthcare, infrastructure, and climate resilience projects. International financial officials urged comprehensive debt restructuring agreements to prevent cascading sovereign defaults.

stories.title: Buckingham Palace Signals Willingness to Accept Commonwealth Realm Exits
stories.details: Buckingham Palace stated it is fully open to Commonwealth realms choosing to remove King Charles as their official head of state. Royal officials indicated that the monarchy will not contest decisions by member nations seeking to transition into independent republics. The announcement marks an accommodating approach to constitutional reform across former British overseas territories.

stories.title: Thomas Markle Jr Named Person of Interest in Philippine Sexual Abuse Probe
stories.details: Law enforcement authorities in the Philippines identified Thomas Markle Jr, the estranged half-brother of the Duchess of Sussex, as a person of interest in a criminal child sexual abuse investigation. Philippine investigators confirmed that the inquiry remains active as they gather testimony and evidence. The probe places another member of the Markle family under international legal scrutiny.
